verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a scheduling SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows none. The "Delegate to an assistant" items describe giving a human assistant their own login, which is an adjacent feature, not AI. The MCP support lets external AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT operate SavvyCal, which is a different story from an in-product assistant and earns no credit here.
